note: RENAMED FROM 2026-08-13-einarsson-docket.json, and the rename is the point — it is the documented workaround from 2026-08-05, applied because the chairman walked into the documented trap. scripts/fetch_relay.py selects with newest_request() = sorted(glob('*.json'))[-1], a LEXICOGRAPHIC sort. 'einarsson-docket' sorts before 'uncitral-digest-control', so the push of the original filename RE-RAN today's already-completed uncitral control batch (run 31695899871, 11:32:13Z) and OVERWROTE its reduction in place — the original is preserved at commit 95c0b53 — while these six rows were never fetched at all. The 'zz-' prefix forces this file to sort last so the batch actually runs. A workaround is not a fix, and no fix is applied: both relay fixes sit on the operator's PENDING list and code changes are not authorised. 2026-08-13, THIRD batch, chairman-authorised, PRE-REGISTERED BEFORE ANY RESULT EXISTS. It exists because the analyst's Finding 3 identified something the council should have asked weeks ago: the administering institution's OWN docket page for ICSID Case No. UNCT/20/6 (Einarsson and others v. Canada) — the most on-theme pending item this project holds, a NAFTA Chapter 11 claim asserting copyright and trade-secret protection over marine seismic survey data as the covered investment. It is on ALLOWED_HOSTS and, per his disk check across analytics/fetch-requests/ and analytics/fetch-results/, has never been requested. The analyst proposed it as a next step for a later batch; I am firing it today, because the relay is alive today and the docket-page-before-document-hunt rule says this is the question that should have been asked first. The mechanism is proven: the identically-shaped row case-detail?CaseNo=ARB/22/2 with find 'Latest Development' was fired on 2026-08-06 and produced the Huawei docket read.
